subject: Discovery call recap — Redwood x Lumina Tech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@luminainc.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@luminainc.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call recap — Redwood x Lumina Tech

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today. Quick recap from our discovery and the areas where Redwood might help Lumina:

- Performance: You need sub-200ms 95th-token latency for conversational support at 50–100 req/s.
- Data isolation: Must support Private/VPC deployment and KMS integration for PII-sensitive inference.
- Cost predictability: Looking for committed monthly throughput (reserved capacity) with predictable unit economics.
- Model flexibility: Preference for an open-model stack with ability to pin model versions and fall back to smaller variants.

Next steps I proposed:
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra lead — 45 minutes to go over networking and deployment patterns (we can bring our infra eng).
2) Draft of a mutual action plan and a ballpark pricing/commit proposal for Dedicated capacity.

I've attached a short deck that summarizes our architecture and a sample MA plan.

Attachments: discovery-deck.pdf (1.2MB stub)

Would you be available for a technical deep-dive next week? I pasted a few time slots below—if none work, share a slot that does.

- Tue 3/2, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 3/3, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu 3/4, 14:00–14:45 PT

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
